text: {"reconstruction":3,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal gets the Booking→Xe→Mail sequence and the subject/body templates right, but it drops the rule \"first hotel with a review score of 8 or more\" in favor of a vague hotel_choice, splits traveler into a recipient parameter and an unbound {name}, and says to send the email when the true workflow forbids Send and discards, so an automation built from it would be underspecified and would take an unwanted outward-facing action."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the Booking→Xe→Mail sequence and the subject/body templates right, but it drops the rule "first hotel with a review score of 8 or more" in favor of a vague hotel_choice, splits traveler into a recipient parameter and an unbound {name}, and says to send the email when the true workflow forbids Send and discards, so an automation built from it would be underspecified and would take an unwanted outward-facing action.
